factual_methodology.summary: ICI weekly long-term estimated flows, money-market assets, September gold ETF report, and IMF COFER checked against primary sources; stock, flow, valuation, universe and period distinguished.

novelty.summary: Week-end 30 September fund-flow reversal, 7 October money-market increase, September WGC gold ETF report, distinct from 5 October.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Full EN/PT-BR semantic parity and research prose; staging build and validation success.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: 1 table, 2 charts, 1 flow, 1 map per locale
visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Quantities and units reproduced from referenced research, dates distinguish estimates, forecasts and scheduled events; bilingual parity.

contrary_evidence: One negative combined flow week is not a persistent trend.
Money-market balances do not census world liquidity.
Gold ETF holdings and subscriptions can rise while AUM falls.
limitations: Different data universes and time windows for ICI combined flows, ICI money-market assets and WGC gold ETFs.
IMF COFER is quarterly, excludes monetary gold, and does not capture private ETF holdings.
notes: Primary sources and bilingual visuals reviewed; staging validation run https://github.com/logicvisionai/marginalthinking/actions/runs/38205500704 successful.
